lead: I'm an engineering leader and technology strategist, currently VP Engineering & Executive Director (India) at realfast.
paragraphs: I build engineering organisations that ship AI where mistakes are expensive — regulated, audited, enterprise. Right now that's realfast, where I started the India engineering team at one person and it's now past fifty, and where we took SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 end to end.
Before that, six years at Gojek building the platforms a few thousand engineers deployed on — the kind of work where success looks like nobody noticing. Before that, McKinsey.

I still write code most weeks. The part of this job I enjoy most is when a system finally does the boring thing reliably: a deploy that takes five minutes instead of two weeks, or a harness that turns an agent from a slot machine into something you'd let near production.
writing: Writing here since 2017, mostly on enterprise AI, harness engineering and engineering leadership.
bio: Rajnish Dashora is VP Engineering & Executive Director (India) at realfast, where he built the India engineering organisation from the first hire past fifty and led SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certification end to end. He previously ran cloud and mobile platforms at Gojek and was a digital analyst at McKinsey & Company. He writes on enterprise AI, harness engineering and engineering leadership.
